title: Result Day, Ep 1: Chawal Ka Dabba
logline: A daughter-in-law treated as the household help is secretly studying for the civil services exam at 4 a.m., until her mother-in-law finds the books hidden in the rice.
trend_basis: Family cruelty and payback dramas in Hindi and Urdu fill this week's top 'AI story' results (491K, 486K, 576K views)
Hidden-identity stories have the highest median views of any title habit in the scan, though from only five videos
Episode numbering appears in 22% of short videos; one-minute episodes fit India's micro-drama growth
original_twist: No villain's downfall and no secret millionaire: the hidden identity is a housewife who is a serious civil services aspirant, and each episode is one obstacle between her and exam day, told from inside an ordinary Lucknow kitchen.

series.title: Result Day
series.season_arc: Six days to the exam and then the wait for the result: Meera has to reach the exam hall, and the family has to decide who she is to them.
series.cliffhanger: Sarla holds Meera's admit card over the gas flame as Meera walks in.

story.opening_hook: At 4 a.m. a woman's hands bury a thick textbook inside the family's rice container.
hook_variants: Open on the admit card held over the gas flame, freeze, then text: 'Baarah ghante pehle.'
Open on Sarla telling the neighbour 'ek roti gol nahi banti' while, behind her, Meera silently mouths an answer from memory.

acts.name: Hook
acts.summary: The book goes into the rice.

acts.name: Secret
acts.summary: Meera studies before dawn and hides it when the house wakes.

acts.name: House
acts.summary: A normal day: taunts from Sarla, a husband who does not look up.

acts.name: Stakes
acts.summary: The exam is six days away and the admit card is folded in her saree.

acts.name: Discovery
acts.summary: Sarla finds the books and the admit card.

story.ending: Sarla holds the admit card above the flame and asks how this happened behind her back; Meera stands frozen in the doorway.
